From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + evidence staging & capacity uplift

Quick numbers from infra: assuming baseline Brightline throughput profile (avg 250 QPS log ingestion during normal ops) — a 2x bump for the 4-week audit spike maps to ~500 QPS sustained. Two feasible approaches: 

A) Short-term Dedicated burst: reserve 2 additional GPU pools for 30 days. Estimated incremental cost: $18k for the 30-day block. Pros: predictable latency, isolated billing.

B) Seat uplift on existing Dedicated contract: increase concurrent seat limit from current 40 to 80 for the audit period and pay per-seat pro rata. Estimated incremental cost: $12k for 30 days. Pros: cheaper, simpler to configure but slightly noisier multitenant performance.

Note: both options require a prep window of ~7 business days to provision and validate KV-cache priming and prefix caching. We'll include a verification runbook.

[attachment: cost_estimate_brightline_2x.pdf (pdf)]
